description: Plan up to 6 HelloFresh delivery weeks in one read, each for the planner profile the caller names (hf_list_profiles): every week gets the same answer as hf_weekly_plan (box size needed, picks with alternates, price, summary, follow-up writes), and no recipe planned for an earlier week is suggested again in a later one (on top of the recent-picks rule). Returns a combined summary (one line per week), the total of HelloFresh’s own box prices (weeks with only a local estimate are named, not added), and the follow-up write calls per week in order (hf_set_week_size where needed, then hf_select_meals). A skipped week is reported as skipped, with no suggestions; a week whose menu HelloFresh has not published yet is reported as menu_not_published. Which profile each week gets (e.g. from a calendar) is the caller’s decision: this tool does not read a calendar. Read-only: it changes nothing.

weeks.description: The weeks to plan (1–6), each with the profile the caller decided applies to it; planned in week order.

profile.description: The planner profile to plan for, by name (hf_list_profiles lists them; the built-ins are "couple", "family"). A profile sets the servings and meal count, the allowed recipe categories, and what to favour (kid friendly, quick, adventurous) and the premium cap. Decide which profile applies to the week before calling.

week.description: The delivery week as an ISO week, e.g. 2026-W49 (from hf_list_deliveries).

name: hf_plan_weeks
